articles.title: Explained: How Korea’s SK Hynix triggered massive $17.4 million in crypto losses?
articles.content: A rogue pre-market trade in SK Hynix shares in Seoul triggered a 20% flash drop in crypto perpetual contracts on Hyperliquid. The oracle price anomaly wiped out nearly $60 million in long positions, resulting in $17.4 million in realised losses for over 900 crypto traders.

articles.title: IT stocks on a roll: TCS, Infosys, Coforge and others rally up to 5% for second straight day. What's driving this surge?
articles.content: Indian IT stocks rallied for a second straight session, buoyed by strong Q1 earnings, optimism around AI-driven demand and improving investor sentiment. The rally came despite a global tech selloff, with investors also awaiting the US Federal Reserve's policy decision.

articles.title: Tata Capital shares rally 4% after Q1 profit surges 56%; AUM nears Rs 3 lakh crore
articles.content: Tata Capital shares rose nearly 4% on Wednesday following a stellar Q1 FY27 performance. articles.title: Varun Beverages shares jump 3% after Q1 PAT rises 15%, revenue grows 20%
articles.content: Varun Beverages reported a 15% profit and 20% revenue increase in Q1 FY2027. Consolidated sales volumes grew by nearly 20% driven by India and international markets. A second interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share was approved by the board.

articles.title: Kospi crashes 12% after SK Hynix earnings; best performing Asian market of 2026 plunges 43% in a month. What’s ahead?

articles.title: Rupee rises 5 paise to 95.77 against US dollar in early trade
articles.content: The rupee strengthened by five paise to 95.77 against the US dollar on Wednesday.  This appreciation marks the fourth consecutive day of gains for the Indian currency.  Foreign institutional investors turned to buying Indian stocks, supporting the local market sentiment.  Meanwhile, the dollar index traded lower ahead of Federal Reserve policy announcements.  Crude oil prices saw a rise after an overnight incident involving Iran and US forces.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Bond investors turn cautious ahead of Fed meeting as inflation risks cloud rate outlook
articles.content: Bond investors are adopting a cautious stance before the Federal Reserve policy meeting. Uncertainty over inflation and interest rates pushes them towards high-quality assets. Investors are prioritizing liquidity and risk management while awaiting clearer economic signals.

articles.title: Global Market | AI boom, market correction risks emerge as major credit threats: Fitch
articles.content: Ratings agency Fitch highlights AI boom and market correction as major global credit risks. Unprecedented AI spending and soaring valuations may outpace uncertain future returns, Fitch stated. Geopolitical tensions, particularly the U.S.-Iran conflict, add further significant challenges to the credit environment. Emerging markets face additional pressure from rising costs and climate-related shocks. Policymakers and investors navigate increasing dependence on AI investment amid global uncertainties.
